blocks.text: Architecting a Unified Security Fabric for a Global Customer Experience Leader
IT-Enabled Services
Client
A specialist in customer interaction and experience management, handling billions of customer interactions per year.
Ambition
To move beyond basic security and implement a comprehensive, modern security solution to protect against advanced threats and manage a huge, diverse user base.
Outcome
Architected and deployed a unified, SaaS-based security platform that provided identity-based protection, advanced threat defense, and robust data protection across all devices.
The Ambition
A specialist in customer interaction and experience management, handling billions of customer interactions per year.
The Challenge

They were struggling with the threat of data breaches and leakage. With a massive user base running on a variety of endpoints, they had no unified solution to monitor network activity or prevent the installation of unauthorized apps. They needed a modern platform that could provide robust identity and access management and defend against threats like ransomware.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to operate with a security posture that matched the scale and criticality of their operations. They needed a foolproof solution to prevent attacks, control network activity, and manage identities for their huge user base, ensuring the integrity of their clients' data.
Ambition, Realized

The unified security solution was a huge success. The identity-based protection model provided the highest level of security. Instead of relying on multiple vendors, they now had a single, integrated solution that was easier to manage and more cost-effective. The rapidly evolving cloud platform ensured they always had protection against the latest threats. This modern, comprehensive security posture gave them and their clients complete confidence.
Key Business Impact
Deployed a Modern, Identity-First Security Model
Unified Security Management on a Single Integrated Platform
Protected Against Advanced & Zero-Day Threats
Reduced TCO by Consolidating Security Vendors
Back to Happy Customer Back to Happy Customer
